description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moratuwella, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses entirely on land property registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
